_comment: Entered ONLY from floodplains' `ruin_door` (door_when-gated). 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.3): that gate moved from door_chain_started to horns_dig_started -- the dig invitation is now the only way in, and the door chain no longer starts before the ruin at all. SPOILER RULE: nothing on this map names a door before the pedestal opens.

arrival_toasts.text: East past the gate road, across the floodplains — this is the ruin. Survey stakes, a banked fire, and someone's washing on a line: the Horns got here first. The sealed level is deeper in, under the pedestal court.

_comment_camp_blocking: 2026-07-26 (Task 2.3): the camp's fire (3,3) and supply crate (5,3) are decor that READS solid, so both join `blocked` per the blocking contract. With ceria_dig_camp on (4,3) that makes y=3 solid across x=3..5, but (2,3)/(6,3)/(3,2)/(4,2)/(5,2)/(3,4)/(4,4) all stay open -- no cell in the new blocked set is a cul-de-sac for a prior-version save that loads standing on it.

floor_layers._pick: ruin floor, reusing the verified cave-floor tile neighborhood (Albez-flavored rubble/stone read).

decor._pick: The dig camp's dressing, pulled from two pack families (campfire + crate) so the corner reads as somebody's occupied camp rather than more cave. Both cells are in `blocked`.

entities._comment: Landing cell (2,2) is one cell south of this door, matching the sewer_exit/deep_fissure 'the way back up' convention.

2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.3): the Horns' dig camp, three steps off the landing cell (2,2) so the first thing the ruin says is 'someone is already here'. Present from the invitation (horns_dig_started) until the find leaves with the haul (door_retrieved) -- the camp strikes its tents with the wagon. Cell (4,3) is off every canonical walked route (ruin_walkthrough walks rows y=1/2/5/13 and columns x=2/17/19) and leaves (4,2)/(3,4)/(4,4)/(6,3) open, so the new blocker traps no prior-version save. No talk_pool: the invitation-follow-up must open on the FIRST interact, not the second.

dialogue.speaker: Ceria
dialogue.text: Mind the survey stakes. We put them there for a reason.

entities.observe: A faceless stone sentinel leans over the court, its shield worn smooth by grit and years. The stance still points toward the cracked plinth.
entities.toast: The sentinel's face is gone, but its posture survives: shield toward the court, warning anyone who follows its gaze.

entities._comment: OR convergence: pedestal_unsealed banks via the guardian court, Pisces TALK/SKILL, or the cellar fight on_victory (see inn.json). Unmet contains_when falls through to locked toast. First open atomically grants anchor_stone + anchor_sliver; repeat is idempotent. b10 #204: recovery beat now ALSO needs rune_sequence_done (the flanking plate pair, west then east; socket read names the order). 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.3): this ONE open is now the whole payoff -- contains_when also gates on horns_dig_joined (quests.json horns_dig's 'pedestal on camp' order rule: no cosmetic skip past the camp), and on_open_accomplishment banks the convergent set [recovered_anchor_stone, pedestal_breached, door_retrieved] so the `breach` beat closes and the `haul` beat opens at the exact instant the reveal renders -- never a beat earlier, which would have put 'carry it home' in the journal before the player knew what 'it' was. SPOILER RULE: open_toast IS the reveal; nothing before it on this map names a door.
entities.observe: A stone rests in a shallow cradle atop the plinth, held there by nothing you can see. Something older than the dust stands close enough to notice you noticing.
entities.open_toast: Below the pedestal: not treasure. A DOOR -- unhung, unmarked, utterly ordinary except that four adventurers go silent around it at once. Ceria, finally: 'That's wardwork. Old, fed wardwork. We're taking it home.' The anchor stone comes up with it.
entities.toast: The stone doesn't move. Whatever holds it there is still standing guard, close enough that reaching for it feels like a very bad idea.

variants.toast: The seal is broken, but the warding still holds the stone fast. Two spiral plates flank the court — the carving beside the pedestal looks like a beginning.

variants._comment: Task 2.3 presence re-skin: same locked beat, but with the dig around it. Later-satisfied-variant-wins, so this replaces the line above once the player has joined the camp. Toast only -- it banks nothing, because everything the pedestal has to give banks together at the open.
variants.toast: The seal is broken and the Horns are already down the gap — Yvlon bracing, Ksmvr counting rope. The warding still holds the stone fast. Two spiral plates flank the court; Ceria points at the carving beside the pedestal and says that one's a beginning.

visual_states._comment: Post-reveal the plinth is a spent, opened thing. Tint + observe swap rather than `hidden`: the plinth still blocks (17,6), and a hidden blocker is the GH#149 invisible-bump class.
visual_states.observe: The cradle on top is empty and the seam beneath it stands open on nothing. Whatever the ruin was built around, the ruin isn't holding it any more.

entities.skill_hint_toast: The socket's empty, but empty like a held breath. The warding reads near-first — the spiral beside the pedestal, then its far twin.
entities.locked_toast: A carved socket in the ruin stone. Whatever sat here, someone carried it off.

on_skill_use.toast: [Detect Magic] — The socket still remembers its stone: a slow pulse, counting toward a door that already left. The warding reads near-first: the spiral beside the pedestal, then its far twin.

entities._comment: CONTRACT: `door_chain_fight.json`'s teleport target must stay in sync at (16,8), the west-adjacent cell.
entities.observe: Stone shaped like a soldier, or close enough that the difference doesn't help you. It hasn't moved since you stepped into this room. That is not the same as harmless.

companion_source.taken_toast: The bones rise and fall into step behind you.

entities.observe: Old bones, settled where they fell. They are not going anywhere. Probably.
A palm-sized plate set flush beside the pedestal, cut with a spiral that walks inward. Faint warmth, like a banked coal.
entities.toast: The spiral takes the press and holds a dull red glow. Something in the pedestal shifts its weight.
entities._comment: b10 #204 recovery-beat puzzle, NEAR plate = FIRST in sequence (beside the pedestal). Far plate banks the sequence only when this one is lit.

entities.observe: The near plate's twin, set apart in the rubble, spiral running the other way. Cold, until its partner isn't.
entities.toast: Cold stone, unlit. The spiral wants something the press alone doesn't give.

variants.toast: Both spirals light — red, then a clean white. The pedestal's seam exhales dust.

entities._comment: b10 #204 FAR plate = SECOND: banks rune_sequence_done ONLY via the variant (near lit); base = wrong-order cold feedback. Order enforced with zero new sim code. Cell (15,4) chosen in-bounds + off every canonical walked cell (the first two placements collided with the promenade column and the GRID EDGE).
